These synthetic fixtures contain a 440 Hz sine wave generated locally with FFmpeg. No user recording or downloaded media is included. Nine two-second files cover WebM/Opus, Ogg/Opus, AAC M4A, ADTS AAC, MP3, FLAC, stereo PCM WAV, Ogg/Vorbis and ALAC. The nineteen-second Ogg/Opus fixture verifies bounded rejection of recordings longer than eighteen seconds. The manifest pins every fixture by size and SHA-256.
